judgments.yea_description: Voted for H.R. 3062, the Promoting Cross-border Energy Infrastructure Act, which replaced the presidential permit process for oil, gas, and electric lines crossing an international border with a faster certificate-of-crossing approval. The House passed it 224-203.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against H.R. 3062, the Promoting Cross-border Energy Infrastructure Act, which replaced the presidential permit process for oil, gas, and electric lines crossing an international border with a faster certificate-of-crossing approval. The House passed it 224-203.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for sending H.J.Res. 104 to the President to cancel the federal land agency plan for the Miles City field office in eastern Montana and reopen those federal lands to coal leasing. The Senate passed it 52-47.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against sending H.J.Res. 104 to the President to cancel the federal land agency plan for the Miles City field office in eastern Montana and reopen those federal lands to coal leasing. The Senate passed it 52-47.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for S.J.Res. 71, which would end the energy emergency declared under Executive Order 14156 on January 20, 2025. The Senate rejected it 47-51, so it did not become law.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against S.J.Res. 71, which would end the energy emergency declared under Executive Order 14156 on January 20, 2025. The Senate rejected it 47-51, so it did not become law.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for sending H.J.Res. 105 to the President to cancel the federal land agency plan for the North Dakota field office that had limited oil and gas development in low-potential areas and narrowed new coal leasing. The Senate passed it 50-45.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against sending H.J.Res. 105 to the President to cancel the federal land agency plan for the North Dakota field office that had limited oil and gas development in low-potential areas and narrowed new coal leasing. The Senate passed it 50-45.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for sending H.J.Res. 106 to the President to cancel the federal land agency plan for Alaska's Central Yukon area and undo its designation of specially protected areas. The Senate passed it 50-46.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against sending H.J.Res. 106 to the President to cancel the federal land agency plan for Alaska's Central Yukon area and undo its designation of specially protected areas. The Senate passed it 50-46.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for S. 2296, the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2026, which set defense policy and authorized funding levels for Defense Department programs, military construction, and the Energy Department's national security programs. The Senate passed it 77-20.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against S. 2296, the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2026, which set defense policy and authorized funding levels for Defense Department programs, military construction, and the Energy Department's national security programs. The Senate passed it 77-20.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for S.J.Res. 81, which terminated the national emergency the President declared on July 30, 2025 to impose an added 40 percent tariff on many imports from Brazil. The Senate passed it 52-48.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against S.J.Res. 81, which terminated the national emergency the President declared on July 30, 2025 to impose an added 40 percent tariff on many imports from Brazil. The Senate passed it 52-48.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for S.J.Res. 77, which terminated the national emergency the President declared on February 1, 2025 to impose an added 25 percent tariff on most imports from Canada and 10 percent on Canadian energy. The Senate passed it 50-46.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against S.J.Res. 77, which terminated the national emergency the President declared on February 1, 2025 to impose an added 25 percent tariff on most imports from Canada and 10 percent on Canadian energy. The Senate passed it 50-46.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for S.J.Res. 80 to cancel the federal land agency's activity plan for the National Petroleum Reserve in Alaska, reopening parts of the 23-million-acre reserve to oil and gas leasing. The Senate passed it 52-45.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against S.J.Res. 80 to cancel the federal land agency's activity plan for the National Petroleum Reserve in Alaska, reopening parts of the 23-million-acre reserve to oil and gas leasing. The Senate passed it 52-45.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for S.J.Res. 88, which terminated the national emergency the President declared on April 2, 2025 to impose a 10 percent tariff on most imports and higher duties on specified trading partners. The Senate passed it 51-47.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against S.J.Res. 88, which terminated the national emergency the President declared on April 2, 2025 to impose a 10 percent tariff on most imports and higher duties on specified trading partners. The Senate passed it 51-47.
